full_page.content:
1928, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 45 Cont. Hopeless Case - two weeks ago - came from Calif. in Airplane - and was at operation - O.Kd! - now going to Calif. - all in two weeks. Clarkson Case !!! Deo Gratias
Hazel Mckechnie non-cath. - abcess on Lung - 4 years sickly.
Almanacs
Page 46
Bidegare - Financial trouble
Richard Gallagher 22 - Kind and Ideal when not drinking - killing Mother by inches through drink
Property - Sell .. Property - & Auto - 5000. for 2000. - 1928 - 262 Hendrie - phone 1504 R
James Kane 4 St . Josephs - (Northway) Mt. Clemens - fever 102 - 106 - wants to be a priest
Mrs. Bechard 72 - Gall-stones .... Fear operation Miss O'hara .. T.B .... raising 3 nephews Mrs. Alma Normandeau - Brain tumor ??? - Operation ?? Wm. Walshan - State-prison Garland Casey
Page 47 Nov. 28 Peter Kaiser 78 - Palsey etc can't walk - wife asks prayers. Brothers fear failure in Business ...
Dr. Stockler ... Sickley .... Yomising, Pa. Mrs. Agnes Roy 57 - Sickley - 3356 Hombolt
Mrs. V. Meldrom 60 - New Baltimore - cured Blood-tumor ... now Rhumatic. ...
John Mccarthy - student doubting about his vocation. ... Mother Heart-broken
